name: Rustic Bakery Ltd.
summary: Rustic Bakery Ltd. is engaged in the production, development and marketing of frozen and baked-frozen bakery products. Its products include bread mixes, english cakes, cookie boxes, baguettes, donuts, muffins, challa, cakes, cookies, filo pastries, italian bread, bread rolls, savory pastries, bagels, and pretzels. The company was founded on October 17, 1996 and is headquartered in Ramla, Israel.
